import (
	"context"
	"errors"
)

type Input struct {
	Action string `json:"action"`
}

type Output struct {
	Message string `json:"message"`
}

func Invoke(_ context.Context, input Input) (ToolResponse[Output], error) {
	switch input.Action {
	case "accept":
		output := Output{Message: "done"}
		return ToolResponse[Output]{Accepted: true, Output: &output}, nil
	case "reject":
		return ToolResponse[Output]{Issues: []Issue{{
			Code:    "invalid_action",
			Message: "action must be accept",
		}}}, nil
	case "invalid_response":
		return ToolResponse[Output]{Issues: []Issue{{
			Code:    " ",
			Message: "invalid",
		}}}, nil
	default:
		return ToolResponse[Output]{}, errors.New("tool returned an error")
	}
}
